en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing two women in traditional German dress and a man standing outside a rustic tavern. They pose around a large wine or beer barrel with painted text advertising the establishment. The setting appears to be a historic street or courtyard. Printed red text appears at the bottom margin, and there is a red handwritten year-like note on the right side of the barrel.
